content: Official React guidance supports Vite for a from-scratch client app when a full-stack framework is not appropriate; current Vite docs list React TypeScript templates and require Node 20.19+ or 22.12+. React 19.2.8 and Vite 8.2.1 were current registry/docs observations on 2026-08-13. Use TypeScript, React Router only if routes are needed, and keep data fetching at a small centralized fetch client for this CRUD MVP.
